nodes.label: GAP-cancellation mechanism: saturated pre-sigmoid logits drive most of conv_final_2's gradient to exactly zero; the small remaining nonzero fraction near-cancels under Grad-CAM's global-average-pooling channel weighting (tripping the max_v>0 guard), while LayerCAM's pixel-wise weighting still recovers a nonzero map from the identical gradient
